case_family: R4_aB (route R4, anchor B at x=10 m)

tier1.selection_rule: frozen before data arrival: per position score = max over its poses of the legacy-vs-Native relative channel error of R4_aB_m45; take the 20 highest, the 10 lowest and the 10 closest to the median; union

tier2.purpose: needed for the bit-exact regeneration self-check (rf_b_apply requires every position)

regeneration_self_check.procedure: python scripts/drive_sim/rf_b_apply.py --poses rf_poses_R4.json --traces traces_R4_aB --mount 0 (then 45); both outputs must match the SHA256 above bit for bit; requires the Tier 2 (all 547 positions)
